note: City of Albion municipal campground in SW Albion, beside the fairgrounds and the Family Aquatic Center. Overflow sites (water and electric only) south of the main campground; site water is on April 1 - October 31. Camping permit from Albion City Hall (Mon-Fri 7-4) or after hours via the police non-emergency line 402-395-2154. --Claude
